pipeline_forecasting.what: Building enough pipeline, keeping it honest and forecasting what will close.

quota_attainment.what: Carrying a number: owning a sales quota or revenue target and consistently meeting it.

territory_account_planning.what: Deciding where to spend selling time: territory plans, account plans and coverage.

prospecting.what: Finding and opening new business: outbound outreach, cold calls, qualifying leads.

deal_negotiation.what: Negotiating commercial terms and structuring partnership or sales agreements through to signature.

consultative_selling.what: Selling by diagnosing the buyer's problem and tailoring a solution, often over long multi-stakeholder cycles.

key_account_mgmt.what: Owning the relationship with important customers and growing the business done with them.

channel_sales.what: Selling through others: distributors, dealers, resellers and systems integrators.

partner_gtm.what: Working with a partner company to market and sell together: joint plans, co-selling, partner enablement.

sales_leadership.what: Hiring, coaching and holding a sales team to its number.

sales_process.what: Defining how the team sells and keeping the machinery (stages, playbooks, CRM discipline, comp plans) working.

renewals_expansion.what: Keeping and growing revenue from existing customers: renewals, upsell, cross-sell, net revenue retention.

onboarding_adoption.what: Getting new customers live and using the product enough to see its value.

customer_health.what: Watching account health signals and running regular business reviews to catch risk and prove value.

proposals_capture.what: Winning competitive bids: capture planning, proposal writing and RFP responses.
